text: The knight lowered his sword and said,
'I cannot stay,' she whispered, turning to leave.
He paced the room until he paused to ask,
Smiling warmly, she reached for his hand.
'Don't go,' he pleaded, grabbing her sleeve.
Standing by the hearth, the king nodded slowly.
Looking out at the rain, she sighed deeply.
They locked eyes before he finally spoke.
'It is finished,' he declared, closing the book.
She leaned in close and murmured,
Slowly shaking his head, he walked away.
His face fell as he realized the truth.
The old man coughed and then began his tale.
Dropping the tray, she gasped in horror.
Silence filled the room until she broke it.
He chuckled softly, his eyes twinkling.
Clearing her throat, the teacher started the lesson.
She stood up and paced the floor nervously.
'Never,' she hissed, slamming the door.
Adjusting his spectacles, he peered closer at the map.
